title: About Dibrugarh University
content: Dibrugarh University was established in 1965. It is located in Dibrugarh, Assam.

title: Academic Departments
content: Departments under Dibrugarh University: Computer Science, Commerce, Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Botany, Zoology, Economics, English, Assamese.

title: Centre for Computer Science and Applications
content: CCSA (Centre for Computer Science and Applications) is a center under Dibrugarh University. It offers BCA, MCA, and PGDCA programs. It does NOT offer BSc or MSc Computer Science.
